data.body: [P2] Remove obsolete strict expected-failure markers. The current base's `_Evidence.recovery()` already rejects release before successful recovery and requires the victim's gate in the fault inventory. These assertions therefore succeed in both validation phases. Integrating this marker and the gate-inventory marker below with that validator produces four `XPASS(strict)` failures, breaking the core test suite. Remove both markers and retain the cases as ordinary regression tests.
